mods.effect: Damage Increases up to +130% as Health Decreases

mods.effect: Grants up to 10% Damage Reduction at lower Health Percent

mods.effect: Being Hit in Melee causes the Player to become Invisible Once Every 30 Seconds

mods.effect: Grants up to 10% Damage Reduction at Higher Encumberance

mods.effect: Damage Increases up to +100% as Health Increases

mods.effect: Damage Increases per Addiction up to +100%

mods.effect: Automatically Revive Yourself with a Stimpak. Cooldown 5 minutes, reduced by 60 seconds per additional Life Saving mod

mods.effect: Attacks will Heal Friendly Targets by 5% Health

mods.effect: Replenish 15 Action Points with Each Kill

mods.effect: The last round in a magazine has a 25% chance to Deal +100% Damage

mods.effect: 5% Chance to deal 18 to 105 Energy Damage per second for 3 seconds to Melee Attackers

mods.effect: 5% Chance to deal 12 to 72 Cryo Damage per second for 4 seconds to Melee Attackers

mods.effect: When Reloading, Gain +500 to All Resistances
